common.meta_title: Zephyrus · Clear by design. Powerful by nature.
common.meta_description: A cohesive PHP framework with attribute routing, JSON localization, explicit SQL, immutable HTTP and an open agent skill.

landing.hero_description_1: A cohesive PHP framework for people
landing.hero_description_2: who care how their software is built.
landing.philosophy_body_1: Good tools make space for good thinking. Zephyrus brings routing, HTTP, configuration and security into one coherent foundation.
landing.philosophy_body_2: Explicit code. Familiar PHP. An architecture you can follow from the first request to the last response.
landing.code_intro_1: Routes live beside the code they run.
landing.code_intro_2: Inputs have types. Responses have purpose.
landing.code_intro_3: The details stay in plain sight.
landing.routing_caption: A direct path to your logic.
landing.code_footnote: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES / API DOCUMENTATION IS BEING UPDATED
landing.architecture_intro_1: One considered path through your application.
landing.architecture_intro_2: Explore the pieces that make it work.
landing.detail_routing_body: PHP attributes connect a URL to a controller method. Typed parameters bring the request into your code with a clear contract.
landing.detail_http_body: Request and response objects keep their state. Changes return a new object, making each step easier to follow.
landing.detail_security_body: Security middleware and validation rules give your application a shared place to handle boundaries and incoming data.
landing.detail_config_body: YAML configuration, environment values and typed sections keep application settings visible and organized.
landing.detail_localization_body: Split translations across JSON files. Nested keys, parameters and formatting pipes keep messages readable. Regional locales fall back to their language, then the configured default.
landing.detail_data_body: Brokers group explicit SQL and bound parameters by domain. Typed query helpers, composable transactions and Entity hydration keep the data path visible.
landing.leaf_body: Markdown to a finished site. Documentation, journals and pages, built on the same foundation.
landing.leaf_note: THIS VERY SITE IS BUILT WITH LEAF.
landing.docs_intro_1: A quiet workspace for learning the framework.
landing.docs_intro_2: The next chapter is taking shape.

features.label: CHOICES THAT MATTER
features.caption: LOOK A LITTLE CLOSER.
features.title: Control where
features.intro: A few deliberate choices inside the core. Useful when an application grows, changes roles or starts talking in real time.

runtime.label: RUNTIME ROLES
runtime.title: One codebase. Several entry points.
runtime.body: Use RequiresEnv on a controller or method to register its routes only when an environment value matches. Web and API roles can share application code while exposing their own routes.

container.label: DEPENDENCY INJECTION
container.title: A small container. Explicit wiring.
container.body: Autowire constructor dependencies, bind interfaces and choose which services are shared. Circular dependencies are detected during resolution.

guards.label: COMPOSABLE ACCESS
guards.title: Access rules you can combine.
guards.body: Compose guards with all, any and not logic, then apply them through middleware. The same core also supplies CSRF, CSP and secure-header middleware.

streaming.label: EVENT STREAMING
streaming.title: A generator. A live conversation.
streaming.body: Stream Server-Sent Events from a PHP generator. Typed SseEvent messages carry data, event names, IDs and retry values, with multiline data handled for you.

features.source: Follow these choices in the core

agents.label: READY FOR AGENTIC DEVELOPMENT
agents.title: Your agent.
agents.body: Give your coding agent the conventions behind the code. The Zephyrus skill brings routing patterns, application structure and practical integration notes into its working context.
agents.scope: Attribute routes. Middleware registration. Broker, Service and Entity patterns. JSON localization. Latte templates. Configuration and testing conventions.
agents.install_note: Run in your project, then choose your coding agents. The installer supports tools that implement the Agent Skills format.
agents.standard: Built on the open Agent Skills format
